correctness.rationale: The support-intersection reduction is exact; if I_c={c,d} then every c-supporter ballot equals {c,d}, making c degree <=1 in the graph. Every edge therefore has a leaf, so graph components are stars and each has one candidate hitting all component requirements. This proves the top-k weight formula with padding. Cubic graph edges as two-approval voters and vertex candidates, k>=|V|/2, yield all candidates cohesive and make SSJR equivalent to vertex cover. Trivial K regions map to fixed promised instances. Independent exact script verifies 67,028 bounded profiles, 4,822 groupwise committees and the cubic examples; enumeration is not substituted for proof.
